title: Quick Crispy Brazilian Coconut Flatbread
description: Savory and crisp Brazilian flatbread with desiccated coconut, perfect for a romantic or temple-friendly snack.
instructions: Combine flour, desiccated coconut, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a large bowl.
Stir in active dry yeast until evenly distributed.
Add warm water and olive oil and mix until a sticky dough forms.
Turn dough onto a floured surface and knead for 5 minutes until smooth.
Return dough to the bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let rise for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Punch down the dough, divide into eight equal portions, and roll each into a thin circle about 4 inches in diameter.
Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the dough circles on the preheated Lazy Susan Spinner, ensuring they are separated, and bake for 10 minutes until golden and crisp.
Remove from oven, sprinkle with chopped cilantro if desired, and serve warm.
